comment: The jellyfin-web anchors Bookmarks uses, the one place their selectors are written. Kit.props embeds this file as Web.anchors.json: the kit's EmbeddedScript puts it into the ClientScript (kit.anchors.find/all, reached through Web/js/10-selectors.js), the server accepts only these names and views in ClientHealth reports, and scripts/Test-WebAnchors.ps1 looks for them in the installed jellyfin-web bundle. css is the primary selector, then the fallbacks, tried in order. Notes cite the jellyfin-web 10.11.5 chunk and Bookmarks 1.0 (bm:Web/bookmarks.js).

anchors.name: detailPage
anchors.note: The shown item details view (itemDetails-index-html chunk; several cached views exist). bm:Web/bookmarks.js:1134. Missing: no details-page UI.

anchors.name: detailContent
anchors.note: The content column inside detailPage; the Bookmarks section goes first in it (itemDetails-index-html chunk). bm:Web/bookmarks.js:1134-1251. Missing: no section and no button.

anchors.name: detailButtons
anchors.note: The button row inside detailPage (itemDetails-index-html and itemDetails chunks). bm:Web/bookmarks.js:1210-1225. Missing: no Add bookmark button; the section still works.

anchors.name: detailButtonsBefore
anchors.note: The "more" button inside detailButtons; Add bookmark goes right before it (itemDetails-index-html and itemDetails chunks). Missing: the button is appended at the end of the row.

anchors.name: playerPage
anchors.note: The video player view; the player is open while one of them isn't hidden: played again and again from a page of ours, the web client keeps up to three, the earlier ones hidden and not always after the shown one (playback-video-index-html chunk). bm:Web/bookmarks.js:328. Missing: B and the player buttons report "start playing a video".

anchors.name: osdButtons
anchors.note: The player's on-screen button row (playback-video-index-html and playback-video chunks). bm:Web/bookmarks.js:955-986. Missing: no player buttons; B still bookmarks.

anchors.name: osdInsertBefore
anchors.note: The first of these inside osdButtons gets our three buttons before it (playback-video-index-html and playback-video chunks). bm:Web/bookmarks.js:955-986. Missing: the buttons are appended at the end.

anchors.name: osdPositionSlider
anchors.note: The player's position slider inside playerPage; the timeline marks go in a layer of their own in its parent, the slider container emby-slider sizes and positions, beside its chapter marks (playback-video-index-html chunk; emby-slider). Missing: no timeline marks; the Bookmarks list still jumps.

anchors.name: videoElement
anchors.note: The playing video element, for positions between two playback reports (htmlVideoPlayer-plugin chunk). bm:Web/bookmarks.js:324, 392-418. Missing: the position comes from the playback reports alone.
